text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This balances visibility for keyboard users with subtlety to avoid cluttering the interface. The glow improves contrast on busy backgrounds without overwhelming the design. Trade-off: it’s slightly less prominent than a 3-pixel ring, but that’s intentional to keep the focus indicator clean and consistent with our brand’s minimalist style.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 2px glow bleeds at 125% zoom—it’s not just "slightly less prominent." A 1px ring + 1px glow at 30% opacity keeps focus visible without obscuring content at any zoom. Test it at 125% zoom with a high-contrast theme; if it passes, adopt it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 1-pixel solid focus ring with a 1-pixel outer glow at 30% opacity. This keeps the ring sharp at 125% zoom and high-contrast themes while maintaining visibility for keyboard users. The glow adds contrast without bleeding or clutter. Trade-off: it’s less prominent than thicker rings, but that’s the cost of reliability across zoom levels.

name: Reader
text: Reader: The 1px ring + 1px glow risks disappearing on low-contrast backgrounds—especially at 125% zoom where anti-aliasing thins the stroke. Test it on a #777 background at 125% zoom; if it vanishes, adopt a 1px ring + 2px glow at 25% opacity instead.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a 1px solid #0078D4 focus ring with a 2px outer glow at 25% opacity. The result must deliver a tested, zoom-safe focus indicator that remains visible on low-contrast backgrounds at 125% zoom. Owned by Ramp (accessibility-w1).
